steps.title: Crundi can do it, not just tell you
steps.body: Ask by voice and Crundi acts: sends a message into a chat, starts, closes or parks one, tells you when one finishes, adds cards and notes, edits the mindmap, and schedules messages and tasks. Anything weighty it asks first, and you answer yes or no out loud. It never types into a terminal.

steps.title: Claude and Deepgram, apart
steps.body: The usage window shows the voice assistant's Claude API and Deepgram spend separately, each with its own month and limit. With an Admin API key on the voice page, it also shows what Anthropic reports for the whole account.
